mode: Built-in ChatGPT image generation, referenced-image edits
purpose: User-approved AI enhancement previews published on the Flow project page
notes: These are clarity re-renders, not content-exact super-resolution. Fine geometry and drawing lines require review.

images.name: Physical model
images.prompt: Create a conservative AI-enhanced PREVIEW of the supplied existing image. This is a clarity/restoration pass, not a redesign or new composition. Preserve the exact original viewpoint, complete framing, aspect ratio and all subject positions. Improve soft/blurry edges, visible compression and distracting coarse noise; keep a natural photographic or drawn appearance as appropriate. Do not invent new design features, delete parts, change geometry, add text or labels, add objects, crop, stylise, colourise, add exaggerated texture, sharpen with halos or make it glossy. Preserve subtle existing imperfections. Deliver the highest available native resolution and clean fine detail. No added watermarks or borders. The subject is a real handmade white paper model photographed on grey-white board. Keep every separate ribbon, cut edge, slot, overlap, tiny construction mark and curled/raised tip in the same place and shape. The asymmetry and hand-made irregularities are important. Clean up grain and make paper edges easier to see, maintaining the exact original strong cast shadows and grey background tonal structure. Do not transform the paper into a building, concrete, a CAD render or a perfect digital sculpture.
